arithmetic.check_inputs: CPU inputs validated; core checks disabled; finish and phase-hook checks retained

benchmarks.qualification_limit: Synthetic resident-kernel and single-use measurements; not end-to-end sampled receiver throughput or an exhaustive near-threshold precision qualification.
benchmarks.scope:
Isolated RBPF CPU/CUDA kernel and precision benchmark, not a modem trial.

All devices consume the same CPU-generated r/G and declared finite phase bank.
The bank is independent of observations, with no adaptive resampling or best-
seed selection. Its CPU generation, transfer, initialization/filtering, finish,
and complete single-use times are charged separately. This synthetic Gaussian
workload cannot establish waveform sensitivity, oscillator realism, or calibrated
operational admission. Actual sampled receiver validation is a separate study.

Cheap default: --batches 8 --particles 32 --blocks 8 --devices cpu
Larger explicit run: --batches 32,128,256 --particles 128,512,2048 --blocks 64
                    --devices cpu,cuda:0 --output fresh-result.json

confidence_conventions.cp: Exact pointwise binomial Clopper-Pearson; each endpoint is separately one-sided 95%, not a joint two-sided 95% interval.
confidence_conventions.fixed_strata: Independent physical paths, fixed source-bit strata; constant success probability within each bit stratum. Equal bit weights. Campaign source bits and distinct seed roots are checked. Pointwise, not simultaneous over methods/cohorts or optional stopping.
confidence_conventions.null: Control bounds concern one completed capture. Sparse null/wrong-key captures cannot empirically establish a daily false-admission rate.
confidence_conventions.pooled: Pooled CP is conditional on iid trials. Per-bit CP allows different bit-stratum probabilities. The balanced all-success AM-GM bound does not require equal probabilities across bits.
confidence_conventions.selection: No simultaneous coverage across reported cohorts/methods/gates; no optional-stopping qualification. Screen, pilot, holdout and paired stress configurations are never pooled.

energy_scope: Actual elapsed is transmitted source calendar duration; sampled capture duration also includes capture padding/tails. Signal-energy seconds divide manifest sampled energy by sample rate; E/N0 uses reference manifest noise variance. Evaluation-only signal truth is not used to score candidates.

shared.relaxed_calibration: Re-gates existing scores only; retains stricter original calibration, without refitting or recomputing a relaxed calibration bound.
shared.validity: Family accounting under each method's stated likelihood/noise/calibration assumptions. Not an empirical proof of operational false-admission probability or arbitrary adaptive monitoring.
